closed_by.title: Apple Mac Pro 4,1 Firmware Upgrade to 5,1 in 2024
closed_by.note: Personal blog article, not a forum (HTML title 'Apple Mac Pro 4,1 Firmware Upgrade to 5,1 in 2024 | Jensd's I/O buffer'). Published September 10, 2024 (time datetime 2024-09-10T23:39:55+02:00; the page displays 10/09/2024 day first). Title contains every key term: Mac Pro, 4,1, 5,1, Firmware, Upgrade. Position 4 in all four runs of the exact query (unquoted, with commas, partly quoted, and with 'guide' appended). It also closes the gap in substance: it explains why the Mac Pro 2009-2010 Firmware Tool (posted by MacEFIRom on netkas.org in 2011) no longer flashes in 2024 because it cannot download firmware files (error 5570), then gives a step-by-step workaround: be on MP41.0081.B07 or MP41.0081.B08, disable SIP on El Capitan, use an original EFI card that shows a boot screen; the flash leaves the machine on MP51.007F.B03, and it points to the MacRumors BootROM thread for 144.0.0.0.0. 74 reader comments dated September 14, 2024 to May 31, 2026, so the page is live and maintained.
